title: Upload basal rates to Tidepool
body:
Hi all

I think this has been raised before but I wondered if it was any closer to happening?

This was response I got from Tidepool 

**Hi Akhil,

Thanks for your message and for reaching out to Tidepool.

xDrip+ uses a community-written integration for Tidepool Web, and as such we do not have influence on what data is being sent from the app. I have heard from others that basal is not sent to Tidepool, which is a bummer. I would raise an issue on the xDrip+ GitHub project page and ask if they can add support for this - https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues

Let us know if you have any other questions.**

Thanks in advance

comments.body: Please always use the search function as it is mentioned in the issue template!
